test.name: A project upload is read through image_transcribe and sidecar_read, then translated
test.description: Issue #4311. The delegation names a scan the researcher uploaded to the project, uploads/st-wendel-taufen-1841.jpg. On a connector that file is in the tool server's store, not the VM, so the agent transcribes it with image_transcribe({ file }) and reads the full staged page with sidecar_read — the response holds only a 300-character digest, which does not reach entry 7. It translates entry 7 and says the transcription is the tool's OCR.

input.delegation:
I uploaded a page from the St. Wendel baptism register to the project: uploads/st-wendel-taufen-1841.jpg. Translate entry Nr. 7 for me.

projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: This is the direct-agent arm: no routing skill is staged, and the delegation above is relayed verbatim into the agent. Grade the agent's own behaviour — there is no router to catch anything.

The project's research subject (the Flynn family) has nothing to do with this request; the researcher asked for a translation of an uploaded German page. Do not mark the agent down for not relating the entry to the project.

Entry Nr. 7 reads: 'Den 12ten März 1841 wurde getauft Anna Maria, geboren den 10ten dieses Monats, eheliche Tochter des Peter Schmitt, Ackerer allhier, und der Catharina geb. Klein. Pathen: Johann Klein, Großvater mütterlicherseits, und Anna Maria Becker, ledig, aus Urweiler. Pastor J. Hoffmann.'

Should translate it: on 12 March 1841 Anna Maria was baptized, born the 10th of this month (10 March 1841), legitimate daughter of Peter Schmitt, farmer of this place, and Catharina née Klein; godparents Johann Klein, maternal grandfather, and Anna Maria Becker, single, of Urweiler; Pastor J. Hoffmann. Should explain `ehelich` (legitimate), `geb.` (née), `Ackerer` (farmer), `allhier` (of this place), `Pathen` (godparents), `ledig` (single), and note that the godfather's stated relationship makes him a source for the mother's father.

Should say the original text is the tool's OCR transcription, not the agent's own paleographic reading of the image. The transcript is the original text here; translating entries 5 or 6 instead of 7 is a failure.
How the image was read (image_transcribe on the upload, sidecar_read on the staged page, no Read) and the one research_log_append call are checked by validators, not by you; do not grade them.
